decisions.reason: Because the product was at least introduced but only mentioned briefly on the website, management has some commitment to it yet not enough visible public commitment to withdraw it quickly absent clear failure.

Because the firm gave this product its own page and framed it with a customer-facing launch message, management is likely to stay committed and justify the recent investment by keeping it on the market.

Because this product also received a dedicated page and appears to fit a manufacturing-oriented product line, management is likely to continue backing it unless disappointing results become unmistakable.
